No code change. The repo has no reference to claude-sonnet-4-5 or claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929. A search for 20250929, sonnet-4.5 and sonnet_4_5 also found nothing. The Claude default in src/api.js:10 and in README.md and README.zh.md is claude-sonnet-4-6, which this retirement does not cover.

None intended.

change.title: npm @anthropic-ai/sdk 1.0.0 sends API version 2026-10-21 by default; MessageParam becomes a union, temperature/top_p/top_k removed, Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry SDKs must move to v1 too

source.quote: * **api:** add support for new API version 2026-10-21

tasks.reasoning:
The repo pins @anthropic-ai/sdk 0.55.1 (package-lock.json). SDK 1.0.0 is a breaking major that defaults to API version 2026-10-21, removes temperature/top_p/top_k and turns MessageParam into a union. Nothing in the source says the old SDK or the 2023-06-01 API version stop working, so this is an opportunistic upgrade, not a forced one. The current call site uses no removed parameters, no document blocks in assistant turns and no citations in user turns, so the upgrade should be mostly mechanical. The agent should bump the SDK, verify messages.stream event handling still works, check that no temperature or top_p is set anywhere, and review the OpenTelemetry default.
This task also resolves these changes. Handle each in the same change, and say in the PR how:
- anthropic:2026-10-21-api-version-2026-10-21 (api-version): New Claude API version 2026-10-21 (anthropic-version header); SDKs older than the new majors keep sending 2023-06-01. SDK 1.0.0 is what moves the anthropic-version header from 2023-06-01 to 2026-10-21. The repo on 0.55.1 keeps sending 2023-06-01 until this upgrade.
  Source: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/migration-2026-10-21.md
  "This guide lists the code changes for moving from API version `2023-06-01` to `2026-10-21`."
- anthropic:2026-10-21-sampling-params-removed (field-removed): In API version 2026-10-21, temperature, top_p and top_k in Messages and Batch requests return 400. temperature, top_p and top_k only return 400 under API version 2026-10-21, which the repo adopts by moving to SDK 1.0.0. The recorded call site sends none of them, but response and option handling was not fully read, so the agent should confirm during the upgrade that none are passed.
  Source: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/migration-2026-10-21.md
  "In `2026-10-21`, a request that sends `temperature`, `top_p`, or `top_k` returns a 400 error, even at the parameter’s default value."
- anthropic:2026-10-14-ts-sdk-otel-default (other): TypeScript SDK 0.134.0 auto-creates OpenTelemetry spans and trace headers if a global tracer provider exists (unsure if affects; opt out with openTelemetry:false). OpenTelemetry auto-instrumentation starts in 0.134.0, which this jump from 0.55.1 crosses. If the app registers a global tracer provider, decide during the upgrade whether to set openTelemetry:false.
  Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-typescript/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md
  "If your app registers a global tracer provider, the SDK will create spans with it after upgrading, and they'll be exported with the rest of your traces."

callSites.why: messages.stream is called through @anthropic-ai/sdk 0.55.1. Upgrading to 1.0.0 changes the default API version to 2026-10-21 and changes MessageParam typing. The call passes model, max_tokens, system and messages, with no sampling params recorded.

review.summary: The only affected call site is src/api.js:95 (`client.messages.stream`). It sends only `model`, `max_tokens`, `system` (a string) and one `{role:'user', content: string}` message. The `verified` grade is defensible for what the mock covers.

concerns.issue: The mocked SSE stream uses the pre-1.0 event shapes (`message_start`, `content_block_delta`/`text_delta`, etc.). If API version 2026-10-21 changes or adds streaming event types or content block types, the loop in src/api.js:streamAnthropic could silently drop output. The test cannot detect this. I could not confirm the 2026-10-21 streaming shape; check the SDK's 1.0.0 stream event types or run one live call.
The default model `claude-sonnet-4-6` and `max_tokens: 8192` are not exercised against the real API under the new version. The mock accepts any model. Confirm the model is accepted under 2026-10-21.

`engines.node` is still >=18.0.0. I could not confirm the minimum Node version @anthropic-ai/sdk 1.0.0 supports; check its package.json `engines` field. The lockfile also adds new transitive deps: @opentelemetry/api, json-schema-to-ts, standardwebhooks, and an optional zod peer.
The SDK license changes from MIT to Apache-2.0. This is compatible with this MIT project, but worth noting for anyone tracking licenses.
package.json has no `test` script. Unless CI invokes this file directly, it will not guard future changes.
